payload.text: Bare intent sync prints the plan for this clone and writes nothing, and intent sync --apply applies it; under P3 the plan has one step, the daemon's non-destructive ingest rule run unchanged from the command line, the same engine and no second implementation: it takes the disk only where it differs from what the store recorded writing, a recorded file the pull removed included, never deletes a row whose file was never written, and is safe beside a running daemon and a peer's write under the hold-unless-moved lock; --apply with --to-disk or --to-store is refused.
